title: Red wrapping paper falls onto a step (real scene)
caption: The paper falls onto the steps; nobody is in the frame and the camera is fixed. The untrained Wan2.2 makes the paper grow larger and larger in the air until it flies into the camera; MoPlan lands it on a step, where it stays. (The real video is not available to us, so only two panels are shown.)
benchmark_detail: first frame from the PisaBench real split, clip 0096 (no person in view)

first_frame.faithful: byte-identical copy of the generation input
first_frame.source: PisaBench real clip 0096, first frame, letterboxed onto a 1280x720 canvas
first_frame.attribution: PisaBench real split (Chenyu Li, Oscar Michel, Xichen Pan, Sainan Liu, Mike Roberts and Saining Xie, arXiv:2503.09595), Hugging Face dataset nyu-visionx/pisa-experiments, Apache-2.0 as declared on its dataset card; modified: letterboxed onto a 1280x720 canvas

protocol.name: moprobe
protocol.image: RGB, resized to 448x256 with LANCZOS (stretched, no crop). The input PNG is the source frame letterboxed onto a 1280x720 (16:9) canvas.

sampler.scheduler: UniPCMultistepScheduler of the Wan2.2 pipeline (flow shift 3.0)
sampler.guidance_note: the same scale is used for the high-noise and the low-noise expert

protocol.output: uint8 frames [37, 256, 448, 3]; the reference hashes are of these frames saved with numpy.save

seed_rule: seed = 42 + (crc32(sample_id) mod 100000), seed index 0; both models use the same seed; the noise comes from torch.Generator('cuda').manual_seed(seed)

panels.label: Wan2.2 (untrained, same seed)
panels.model: untrained Wan2.2-I2V-A14B (Diffusers weights in $WAN_MODEL_DIR), same pipeline without LoRA, adapter or motion condition
panels.command: python generate.py --protocol moprobe --image assets/showcase/03_moprobe_paper_falls/first_frame.png --prompt 'A red wrapping paper falls.' --sample-id ps032-pd --base --out out/showcase/03_moprobe_paper_falls/base.mp4

panels.label: MoPlan (ours)
panels.model: MoPlan final model: Stage-1 motion predictor ($MOPLAN_WEIGHTS/stage1) and the Stage-2 generator (LoRA and motion adapter on both Wan2.2 experts, $MOPLAN_WEIGHTS/stage2/{high,low})
panels.command: python generate.py --protocol moprobe --image assets/showcase/03_moprobe_paper_falls/first_frame.png --prompt 'A red wrapping paper falls.' --sample-id ps032-pd --out out/showcase/03_moprobe_paper_falls/moplan.mp4

composite.encoding: panels stacked side by side (rows stacked vertically), labels burned in, libx264 crf 24, yuv420p
composite.inputs: the generated panels are h264 exports of the reference frames; the real panel is the source video
composite.reproducibility: the composite is a re-encode with burned-in labels and is not byte-reproducible; compare regenerated panels with the per-panel references instead

regenerate: python generate.py --protocol moprobe --image assets/showcase/03_moprobe_paper_falls/first_frame.png --prompt 'A red wrapping paper falls.' --sample-id ps032-pd --base --out out/showcase/03_moprobe_paper_falls/base.mp4
